Tiers.Name: Local small
Tiers.Description: Small local models: chit-chat, rewrite, summarize, translate.

Tiers.Name: Local coder / mini
Tiers.Description: Mid-size local coder models and mini API models: small code tasks, extraction.

Tiers.Name: Strong general
Tiers.Description: Strong general models: everyday reasoning, unmatched prompts.

Tiers.Name: Frontier
Tiers.Description: Frontier models: architecture, debugging, agentic coding.

Tiers.Name: Frontier + deep reasoning
Tiers.Description: Extended reasoning for the hardest problems.

Routes.Name: smalltalk
Utterances: hi there
hello, how are you?
good morning
thanks a lot
thank you for your help
who are you?
tell me a joke
what can you do?

Routes.Name: rewrite-summarize
Routes.Description: Light text transformation that small models handle well.
Utterances: summarize this text
summarize this article in three bullet points
give me a short summary of this email
rewrite this paragraph to sound more professional
fix the grammar and spelling in this sentence
translate this sentence to French
make this message shorter
rephrase this in simpler words

Routes.Name: simple-code
Routes.Description: Small, self-contained coding tasks a local coder model can do.
Utterances: write a regex that matches email addresses
write a unit test for this function
add a docstring to this method
convert this json to yaml
write a commit message for this diff
rename this variable everywhere
write a bash one-liner to count lines in all files

Routes.Name: internal-records
Routes.Description: Sensitive internal data: only local models may answer, even on failover.
Utterances: look up the customer record for account number
show the employee salary history
what is the patient's medical history
find the social security number for this customer
list the invoices for customer id

Routes.Name: deep-reasoning
Utterances: design a scalable architecture for a multi-tenant SaaS platform
compare the trade-offs between event sourcing and CRUD
analyze this contract for legal risks
prove that the square root of two is irrational
write a business strategy for entering the European market
explain step by step how to migrate a monolith to microservices
evaluate the security implications of this authentication flow

Routes.Name: complex-code
Utterances: debug this race condition in my multithreaded code
find the memory leak in this service
refactor this legacy class to use dependency injection
why does this async code deadlock
optimize this SQL query that is timing out
review this pull request for bugs

Routes.Name: agentic-coding
Routes.Description: Multi-step coding work from an agent (Claude Code, Codex): implement, fix, migrate across files.
Utterances: implement this feature across the codebase
add a new endpoint and wire it into the service
fix the failing tests and make the build pass
migrate this project to the new framework version
refactor the module and update every caller
add logging and error handling throughout the service
write the integration tests for this flow
set up CI for this repository

Routes.Name: agent-housekeeping
Routes.Description: Cheap side requests agents make: titles, summaries of their own transcript, command descriptions.
Utterances: write a short title for this conversation
summarize the conversation so far
describe what this command does in a few words
suggest a commit message for these changes
is this a question or a command
extract the file paths mentioned above

Models.Name: claude-code
Models.Description: Claude Code CLI on your own Claude subscription (personal, local use).

Models.Name: copilot
Models.Description: GitHub Copilot CLI on your Copilot plan (uses AI credits from your allowance).

Models.Name: codex
Models.Description: OpenAI Codex CLI on your ChatGPT plan.
